figurative_meaning_en: Not a single person or animal
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাতের অন্ধকারে রাস্তায় জনপ্রাণি দেখা যাচ্ছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: In the dark of night, not a soul or creature is visible on the road.
The battlefield was devoid of any person or animal.
note: Often used to describe eerie emptiness in Bengali narratives
